summary: Equinox Gold filed a Form 6-K attaching a material change report disclosing its definitive arrangement agreement to acquire Orla Mining Ltd., an at-market business combination. Orla shareholders will receive 1.00 Equinox Gold share plus $0.0001 cash per Orla share. The implied combined entity market capitalization is ~$18.5B. The board supports the transaction; voting agreements lock ~20% of Orla shares and ~4% of Equinox shares. The court-approved plan of arrangement under the CBCA requires 66⅔% Orla shareholder and simple majority Equinox shareholder approvals at special meetings expected July 2026. Watch for shareholder vote timing and regulatory clearances; risk-arb spread may narrow on close.
